authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No generic Thassa's Oracle/Consultation or fast-combo packages (decisions, rejected under no-forced-homogenization).
Avoid attack-trigger-only Villains as copy targets.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: No compact win; the deck has to win through combat.
Attack-trigger Villains are poor copy targets.
Loki removed or unable to attack safely.

value.interaction: Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deadly Rollick, Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act, Cyclonic Rift.
value.mana: 34 lands, Sol Ring, Talismans, Dark Ritual; Cavern of Souls and Path of Ancestry for Villains.
value.protection: Swiftfoot Boots, Lightning Greaves, Deflecting Swat.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Loki's attack copy and Villain combat draw are the deck's main engine.
accepted_role.honest_note: There is no compact win: Commander Spellbook finds no combos in the list. The copy enters attacking, so attack-trigger Villains do nothing as targets (M1 loki-01). Loki has to attack and survive combat to generate value.
